newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Twenty die in building collapse in eastern Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Twenty die in building collapse in eastern Nigeria.

text.p: Twenty people were killed when an unfinished three-storey building collapsed in eastern Nigerian city of Enugu on Thursday, newspapers reported on Friday.
The victims were construction workers and people who normally gathered at the site to read newspapers free of charge, the independent Guardian newspaper said.
The cause of the collapse was not determined although some witnesses attributed it to poor quality of materials used in the construction of the building which began four months ago.
